# Category mapping for docs/solutions/

Use the category that best matches the solved problem’s primary failure area or guidance area.

## Bug track

| problem_type | track | category guidance                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------ | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| bug          | bug   | Choose the category that matches the observed failure mode: build-errors, runtime-errors, integration-issues, performance-issues, database-issues, security-issues, ui-bugs, test-failures, or logic-errors. |

## Knowledge track

| problem_type | track     | category guidance                                                                                                                   |
| ------------ | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| knowledge    | knowledge | Choose the category that best matches the domain the guidance applies to. Keep the doc narrowly scoped so it is easy to find later. |

## Notes

- Prefer a stable category over inventing a new one.
- Keep the category aligned with the most likely search term a future agent would use.
- If the guidance spans multiple areas, pick the primary one and cross-reference the rest.
